description: Sends feedback the user explicitly wants to share about the Lightbringer tools: broken or surprising tool behaviour, missing capabilities, or friction. Requires the user’s explicit consent to send the proposed report after seeing its text, category and optional tool name and being informed of the recipient. Requires mcp:write permission. Reports go to a human-reviewed Lightbringer engineering Slack channel. Only the report text, category and optional tool name are sent; no account or client metadata is attached. The destination channel is not visible to the signed-in user. Reports contain only the tool issue the user agreed to share, without conversation transcripts, document text, invention details, or other confidential material.

category.description: The kind of report: bug for broken or surprising behaviour, tool_request for a missing capability, general for anything else

feedback.description: The report text approved by the user for sending: a concise description of the tool issue, without conversation transcripts, document text, invention details, or unrelated task context

tool_name.description: The specific tool the report concerns, when there is one

name: send_developer_feedback
title: Send developer feedback
